name: sol-advisor
description: Cost-aware Codex routing: GPT-6.2 Sol owns decisions and acceptance; lower-cost Luna/Terra workers execute bounded tasks in parallel, reusing valid checks. Astra is excluded for now.

interface.shortDescription: Sol decides; lower-cost Luna/Terra workers execute in parallel to reduce total usage.
interface.longDescription: GPT-6.2 Sol / High in the primary session owns decisions, risky implementation, integration and acceptance. Minimize total usage per accepted task, including planning, context, execution, review and retries. Declare SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools: solo is the default for small or coupled tasks where handoff costs more; delegate uses native GPT-6 Luna / High for bounded coding, exploration, tests and logs, GPT-6 Luna / Max only for fully specified deep technical work, or GPT-6.1 Terra / High for specialty work. Use 2-3 independent lower-cost auxiliaries when beneficial, with no one-worker default maximum and within runtime capacity. Audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-6.2 Sol / High review after root implementation; full combines bounded workers and Sol decisions with independent review. Pause only affected ambiguous or risky work; settled independent tasks may continue. Reuse selected-role preflight within the same unchanged primary session, verified worker identity for related follow-ups, and passing checks for matching inputs, configuration and runtime. Changed inputs or new risks invalidate affected evidence. Public routing evidence is authoritative; missing worker identity fails closed for that lane. High-risk review and observed read-only isolation remain required. GPT-6.2 Astra and all Astra models are excluded for now. Prefer Standard speed.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration with GPT-6.2 Sol to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE, then deliver and verify this task at the lowest total usage.

Delegate bounded work to lower-cost Luna/Terra models, parallelize independent tasks within session limits, reuse valid preflight and verification, and choose audit/full only when independent review is needed. Do not use Astra.
